pierst_nain.text: Come in, bach. That means little one, though round here it means anyone from two to a hundred and two.
Hiraeth is a Welsh word for a homesickness that English has no word for. Fishermen's families knew it well, and so do students in their first term.
Chipgulls are clever. They never go for what you are holding, they go for what you are not watching. Keep chips in a pocket, not a packet.

pierst_boy.text: Nain bakes Welsh cakes on the bakestone every Sunday. Picau ar y maen, cakes on the stone. If I am not home by two, none are left.
